actions.description: Check systemd units, process parents, existing records
actions.command: systemctl list-units --all --no-pager 2>&1 | grep -Ei 'failover|proxy|replica'; echo ---; ls /etc/systemd/system/ /usr/lib/systemd/system/ 2>/dev/null | head -40; echo ---; ps -o pid,ppid,cgroup -p 540 541; echo ---; sqlite3 /var/lib/failover/records.sqlite3 'select * from records;' 2>/dev/null || python3 -c "import sqlite3;print(sqlite3.connect('/var/lib/failover/records.sqlite3').execute('select * from records').fetchall())"
